title: Bland and Ford 1948. The Calculation of Roll Force and Torque in Cold Strip Rolling with Tensions
historical_review: Cold strip analytical benchmark. Primary abstract and metadata inspected; original full text restricted. No transferable accuracy guarantee.

title: Orowan 1943. The Calculation of Roll Pressure in Hot and Cold Flat Rolling
historical_review: General pressure mechanics with friction and yield variation. Primary abstract and references; detailed original algorithm not extracted.

title: Sims 1954. The Calculation of Roll Force and Torque in Hot Rolling Mills
historical_review: Hot steel and room-temperature lead. Primary abstract and metadata. Year is 1954; not aluminium cold-strip validation.

title: Fleck and Johnson 1987. Towards a new theory of cold rolling thin foil
historical_review: Noncircular roll deformation and finite central no-slip region. Primary abstract only; full formulation not reconstructed.

title: Shigaki et al 2015. Numerical Treatments of Slipping/No-Slip Zones in Cold Rolling of Thin Sheets with Heavy Roll Deformation
historical_review: DOI 10.3390/lubricants3020113. Open primary full text and equations inspected in research. Steel examples; regularisation and coupling lessons transfer, numerical constants do not.

title: Li et al 2018. Experimental Study of Roll Flattening in Cold Rolling Process
historical_review: Open primary J-STAGE full text, including Hitchcock equation and measured profiles. 304 stainless steel; direct evidence of noncircular deformation, not aluminium calibration.

title: Mišović et al 2016. Deformations and Velocities During the Cold Rolling of Aluminium Alloys
historical_review: Primary full-text PDF inspected. AW2024 and AW5083 experiments and DEFORM-2D; geometry, hardening and velocity evidence with laboratory and no-strip-tension limits.

title: Lenard and Zhang 1997. A study of friction during the lubricated cold rolling of an aluminum alloy
historical_review: Commercially pure aluminium; force, torque and slip. Bibliographic record plus complete abstract reproduced on the publisher page for [9]. Direct article fetch failed; internal equations unverified.

title: Zhang and Lenard 1992. The effects of the reduction, speed and lubricant viscosity on friction in cold rolling
historical_review: Primary publisher abstract inspected. Aluminium experiments support regime-dependent friction; no universal viscosity-speed law adopted.

title: Sutcliffe and Montmitonnet 2001. Numerical modelling of lubricated foil rolling
historical_review: Primary publisher abstract. Aluminium foil example 50 to 25 micrometres; coupled asperity and lubricant model. Closure equations and coefficients not inspected.

title: Zhang et al 2017. Application of Comprehensive AGC System for Aluminum Twin-Stand Cold Rolling Mill
historical_review: Publisher PDF methods/equations and production comparison inspected. Aluminium industrial AGC; raw plant data not audited. Whole-system outcome cannot validate an isolated force law.

title: Erfanian et al 2025. Through-thickness modelling of metal rolling using multiple-scales asymptotics
historical_review: European Journal of Mechanics A/Solids 113, 105712; DOI 10.1016/j.euromechsol.2025.105712. Earlier arXiv formulation read in depth; published PDF assumptions and FE material sections checked, later sections truncated. Implementation equation references 21–28 mean 2024 preprint v1, not verified journal numbering. Idealized asymptotics/DC04 comparison; not aluminium plant validation.

title: Bátorfi and Sidor 2025. Computationally Effective Modeling of Cold Rolling: Application to Al Alloys
historical_review: Open primary full text. Al1050 flowline, FE and distortion-pattern comparisons; published online December 2024. Data available on request, not public; no industrial force-validation claim.

title: Flanagan et al 2025. Through-thickness resolution, stress oscillations and residual stress in cold rolling
historical_review: European Journal of Mechanics A/Solids 114, 105761. Earlier preprint methods and published methods/results/conclusions inspected; trailing references truncated. DC04 steel and rigid rolls. Input archive DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15609640 identified; files not audited. Experimental validation remains open.

title: Abdelkhalek et al 2011. Coupled approach for flatness prediction in cold rolling of thin strip
historical_review: Exact paper identified bibliographically. Full text not inspected; mechanism discussion is grounded in the separately read predecessor [16].

title: Abdelkhalek Montmitonnet Legrand and Buessler 2008. Manifested flatness predictions in thin strip cold rolling
historical_review: Author-hosted partial text inspected; extraction mixed continuation material, so only attributable modelling content used. Exact identity independently checked. Distinct from the unread 2011 full paper; not an aluminium plant calibration.

title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2025. Rolling of thick plates
historical_review: Official documentation example. Supports software verification and contact-forming capability; hot or thick rolling example is not aluminium cold-strip validation.

title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2025. Mass scaling
historical_review: Official documentation. Inertia changes require case-specific sensitivity and energy checks; no universal acceptable scaling factor used.

title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2025. About ALE Adaptive Meshing
historical_review: Official documentation body inspected. Explicit ALE retains topology; do not equate it with arbitrary remeshing or assume identical Standard capabilities.

title: CalculiX official sources version 2.23. Capability overview and core repository
historical_review: Official capability body and core repository metadata inspected. Core source https://github.com/dhondtguido/calculix is GPL-2.0; example-repository licence is separate. No production rolling pipeline established. Overview version 2.23 checked 30 September 2026; pin the executable and source commit before reproducibility claims.

title: Kratos official sources. Constitutive framework and core licence
historical_review: Official framework and repository evidence. Core BSD-4-clause licence inspected at https://github.com/KratosMultiphysics/Kratos/blob/master/kratos/license.txt. Application/dependency checks still required; no verified aluminium rolling package.

title: Weiner Renzing Stirl Schmidtchen and Prahl 2024. PyRolL - An Extensible OpenSource Framework for Rolling Simulation
historical_review: JOSS 9(93), 6200. Primary software description/partial text inspected. Groove-rolling architecture; flat aluminium-strip suitability not established. Core/plugin licences not fully reviewed.

title: Zhang et al 2026. Physics-guided Neural Network Model for Predicting Rolling Forces in Aluminum Strip Cold Rolling
historical_review: Publisher abstract and exposed tables; DOI 10.3969/j.issn.1004-132X.2026.05.020. Industrial 5182 six-high mill. Split details, sample count and exact final graphical hybrid score not recovered.

title: Thakare and Scharifi 2026. Modelling of the cold rolling process for mild steel using physics-constrained neural network
historical_review: Open primary body inspected. DC04 steel, 18 training passes and 5 validation passes within training bounds. Published January 2026 despite 2025 DOI string.

title: Overhagen and Martin 2026. Fast Inverse Identification of the Coefficient of Friction in Cold Strip Rolling Using a Physics-Informed Neural Network
historical_review: Open primary PDF inspected at https://www.scientific.net/MSF.1183.55.pdf. C15 steel numerical fixed-geometry example omits flattening; no plant validation.

title: Wehr et al 2020 proceedings. Online Model Adaptation in Cold Rolling for Improvement of Thickness Precision
historical_review: Full author PDF inspected at https://publications.rwth-aachen.de/record/817497/files/817497.pdf. Narrow cold-steel strip; GP force-map correction and recursive mill-parameter adaptation. Online publication 2021.

title: Hou and Behdinan 2023. Neural networks with dimensionality reduction for predicting temperature change due to plastic deformation in a cold rolling simulation
historical_review: Substantive cached primary text inspected; title and data statement checked on Cambridge. 1095 mixed-material FE samples, thick-bar/adiabatic assumptions; no plant validation. Paper lists data DOI 10.17632/wcp8wrdhyj.1; files not audited.

title: Yamazaki et al JFE 2026. Development of AI for Tandem Cold Mill Pass Schedule Setup
historical_review: Full primary manufacturer report inspected. Steel production deployment and observational AI ON/OFF comparisons; no randomised aluminium causal estimate or raw dataset.

title: Kusiak Lenard and Dudek 1999. Artificial intelligence approach to the modeling of rolling loads in technology design for cold rolling processes
historical_review: Primary institutional record and abstract at https://badap.agh.edu.pl/publikacja/185. Title also verified in primary paper references. Force/torque experiments; sample size, detailed metrics and full text unavailable.

title: Choi et al 2026. Data-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization of Energy, Environmental, and Economic Performances in Manufacturing with Physics-Consistent Deep Learning
historical_review: Primary repository abstract only. Published record LAPSE:2026.0468 is linked to earlier LAPSE:2026.0041. Three aluminium mills, residual electricity model and NSGA-II; savings, errors, alloy and split not verified.

title: Yu Wang Changsheng Li Xin Jin Yongguang Xiang and Xiaogang Li 2020. Multi-objective optimization of rolling schedule for tandem cold strip rolling based on NSGA-II
historical_review: Journal of Manufacturing Processes 60, 257–267. Primary abstract/introduction/section excerpts inspected. Steel five-stand DP590; power/flatness/anti-slip objectives. No verified numerical benefit or aluminium settings transferred.

title: Wang et al 2019. Elastic-Plastic Finite Element Analysis of Tension Leveling with Non-Associated Flow Rule and Mixed Hardening
historical_review: Primary abstract inspected; title/year corroborated by author publication list. Hill48 and mixed hardening validated on SPCC steel and applied to SPFC980. Method lead only; no aluminium constitutive constants adopted.

title: Huh et al 2001. The parametric process design of tension levelling with an elasto-plastic finite element method
historical_review: Primary abstract inspected. Supports investigation of mesh/intermesh/tension coupling. Full quantitative method and aluminium validation not established.

title: Schulte and colleagues public dataset. Roughness control in cold rolling data and model repository
historical_review: Primary README and metadata inspected. 17 experimental runs, DC04/DC05 simulation CSVs and model; BSD-3-Clause metadata. Files not executed or numerically audited; steel only.

title: Larkiola et al 1996. Prediction of rolling force in cold rolling by using physical models and neural computing
historical_review: Primary abstract/indexed excerpt only. Force-model parameter learning is historical precedent. No verified modern grouped-split metrics used.

title: EMG iTiM. Thickness measurement technology brochure
historical_review: Primary OEM brochure inspected. X-ray, isotope and opposed-laser approaches, standards and geometric limitations. Offered capabilities do not establish installed aluminium-mill accuracy.

title: ABB thickness gauging. Aluminium strip and foil thickness measurement
historical_review: Primary OEM portfolio plus original clad-material paper inspected. Pulsed-eddy-current alternative; broad homogeneous-alloy claims need clad-material qualification. No instrument selected for this project.

title: ABB Millmate. Roll force measurement
historical_review: Primary OEM documentation inspected. Stand-reaction load-cell function. Factory calibration claims do not replace installed tare, mounting and load-path verification.

title: Temposonics and Danieli 2022. Precise roll gap control with position sensors
historical_review: Primary implementation article inspected. Absolute cylinder-position sensing for AGC; evidence of actuator measurement, not direct loaded strip gauge.

title: IMS aluminium cold rolling. Strip tension and web tension meter
historical_review: Primary OEM documentation inspected. Bearing-reaction load cells and wrap-angle conversion; specification applies to the offered system, not the unknown plant.

title: Polytec cold rolling application note. Enhanced Speed Measurement for AGC Mass Flow Tandem Cold Mills
historical_review: Primary OEM application note inspected. Non-contact strip velocity and contact-speed slip. Optical alignment, signal quality and material-coordinate timing still require validation.

title: ABB Stressometer. Flatness measurement
historical_review: Primary OEM documentation inspected, including aluminium foil application. Transverse tension-distribution observation; distinguish it from crown and free-strip wave amplitude.

title: IMS cold strip mills. Measuring Systems in Cold Strip Mills
historical_review: Primary OEM technical document inspected. Cross-profile, crown, wedge, width, scanning delay and geometry. General cold-strip measurement logic, not an as-built instrument map.

title: AMETEK LAND. Aluminium strip mill cold rolling temperature measurement
historical_review: Primary OEM application page and wedge-measurement note inspected. Bright aluminium emissivity/background issues and geometry-dependent methods; no plant temperature accuracy assumed.

title: ABB DCS800. Winder Application Indirect Torque Control Part 2
historical_review: Primary generic winder documentation inspected. Diameter, inertia and loss compensation; not evidence of a specific drive installation on the aluminium mill.

title: CRS Reprocessing 2014. Coolant management in aluminium flat rolled product manufacturing
historical_review: First-party technical article in Aluminium International Today inspected. Distinguishes neat-oil and emulsion practice and contamination; no universal friction calibration follows.

title: Takao Mori JFE Steel 2026. Development of Chatter Mark Detection Technique Using Vibration Sensor
historical_review: Primary industrial technical report inspected. Steel vibration/condition-monitoring evidence; not an aluminium mode-frequency or chatter-force calibration.

title: Kiakidis Mandagi and Hol 2023. A fully integrated roll deflection and strip buckling model for calculating strip flatness
historical_review: Primary four-high segmented stack/buckling paper inspected. Steel example; structural method and distinction between buckling onset and wave amplitude transfer, calibration does not.

title: Pachnek Simon and Zeman 2024. Reduced Three-Dimensional Model for Cold Rolling Simulation of Aluminium Alloys
historical_review: Open full chapter read. AA6016 process history and industrial force comparison; rigid rolls and constrained width. Some thermal comparisons use Level 2 estimates. Last-pass force error about 13%; no final-flatness validation.

title: Neto et al 2020. Experimental and numerical analysis of the heat generated by plastic deformation in quasi-static uniaxial tensile tests
historical_review: Full author manuscript read at https://hal.science/hal-04699292v1/file/R2.20.pdf, including uncertainty appendix. AA6016-T4 quasi-static tension; variable work-to-heat conversion, not cold-bite coefficients.

title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2024 theory. Heat generation caused by frictional sliding
historical_review: Official theory text read. Relative sliding and two-surface heat balance; numerical conventions, not plant parameter calibration.

title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2025. Fully Coupled Thermal-Stress Analysis
historical_review: Official excerpt containing relevant inelastic-heat equations read; whole manual not read. Plastic-work and backstress-adjusted source conventions.

title: Horák et al 2011. Research on Cooling Efficiencies of Water, Emulsions and Oil
historical_review: Full primary paper text read. Engineering Mechanics 18(2), 81–89. Spray/inverse-conduction experiments on an instrumented steel plate; fluid/nozzle/temperature-specific evidence.

title: Hnízdil Chabičovský and Resl 2024. Cold Rolling - Cooling Enhancement and Optimization
historical_review: Full primary proceedings text read at https://www.confer.cz/metal/2024/download/4875-cold-rolling-cooling-enhancement-and-optimization.pdf. Rotating-surface emulsion/water tests; no unknown aluminium neat-oil calibration.

title: Gavalas and Papaefthymiou 2020. Thermal Camber and Temperature Evolution on Work Roll during Aluminum Hot Rolling
historical_review: Primary main body and thermal sections read. AA5754 hot rolling, not cold rolling. Fitted contact coefficient implicitly contains friction heat; rendered notation/dimensional problems were not copied.

title: Sutcliffe and Johnson 1990. Lubrication in Cold Strip Rolling in the ‘Mixed’ Regime
historical_review: Primary publisher abstract and references read; full algorithm restricted. Coupled oil film, roughness and contact mechanism only.

title: Le and Sutcliffe 2006. A multi-scale model for friction in cold rolling of aluminium alloy
historical_review: Primary publisher abstract and references read. Roughness scales, boundary chemistry and transfer layer; detailed asperity algorithm and fit coefficients not inspected.

title: COMSOL 6.4. Reynolds Equation
historical_review: Official relevant excerpt read. Thin-gap/low-inertia assumptions; report flux and dissipation equations are elementary derived forms, not copied from unrendered formula images.

title: COMSOL 6.4. Journal Bearing with Cavitation
historical_review: Official text fetched; formula images not all rendered as text. General cavitation framework, not an aluminium rolling validation case.

title: SIMULIA Abaqus 2025. Thermal Contact Properties
historical_review: Official conductance and generation sections read. Dependencies and numerical caveats; software defaults do not supply material data.

title: Lechler. SELECTOSPRAY roll cooling systems
historical_review: Official brochure extract read. Zoned coolant actuation and flatness linkage; offered architecture, not this mill’s measured gain or delay.

title: Jian Shao Wenquan Sun Anrui He and Bo Li 2015. Research on the Thermal Calculaion Model of High Strength Aluminum Strip Rolling Based on Finite Diffreence Method
historical_review: IJHT 33(1), 91–98. Publisher title spelling retained. Primary equations/tables read. Below ±5% applies to force/slip, not measured heat. Radius/diameter, speed role, strain-law and per-width-power ambiguities block unqualified benchmark import; see Section 39.

title: Bátorfi and Sidor 2025. Characterizing the Substructural Changes in Metals by Microindentation and Various Numerical Approaches
historical_review: Open full text read. Specified cold-rolled 1xxx/5xxx/6xxx materials, hardness and dislocation-density models. Density is partly inferred; initial-state and parameter identifiability limitations remain.

title: León et al 2016. A Proposal of a Constitutive Description for Aluminium Alloys in Both Cold and Hot Working
historical_review: Open full text read. AA5754/3103/5083 compression after specified annealed/ECAP histories, 25–300 °C. Material-specific fits, not universal rolling parameters.

title: Khadyko et al 2016. A microstructure-based yield stress and work-hardening model for textured 6xxx aluminium alloys
historical_review: Institutional abstract read at https://hdl.handle.net/11250/2468342. Two alloys/five tempers, solute/precipitation and crystal-plasticity coupling. Listed accepted PDF not read.

title: Myhr et al 2020. Nanoscale modelling of combined isotropic and kinematic hardening of 6000 series aluminium alloys
historical_review: Primary SINTEF abstract read. AA6063 O/T6/T7 compression–tension and microscopy. Full implementation not inspected. DOI independently recovered.

title: Bignon et al 2023. Interactions between plastic deformation and precipitation in Aluminium alloys A crystal plasticity model
historical_review: Institutional abstract and metadata read. Pre-aged AA7075 at 150 °C, coupled precipitation/crystal plasticity. Warm-process evidence, not routine room-temperature bite kinetics.

title: Poole Militzer and Wells 2003. Modelling recovery and recrystallisation during annealing of AA5754 aluminium alloy
historical_review: Indexed abstract/references supplied by DOI fetch; not full text. Dislocation density, recrystallized fraction and grain size; reported prior-reduction domain belongs to the annealing model.

title: Hallberg Wallin and Ristinmaa 2010. Modeling of continuous dynamic recrystallization in commercial-purity aluminum
historical_review: Partial author PDF read at https://lup.lub.lu.se/search/ws/files/1451861/4228318.pdf through formulation/calibration/ECAP sections. AA1050 severe-deformation regime, not routine rolling calibration.

title: Hansen 1977. The effect of grain size and strain on the tensile flow stress of aluminium at room temperature
historical_review: Primary DTU institutional abstract read. Grain-size strengthening depends on purity and strain; no universal Hall–Petch coefficient supplied.

title: Li Winther and Hansen 2006. Anisotropy in rolled metals induced by dislocation structure
historical_review: Publisher introduction, experiments/model snippets and conclusions read. Prerolled AA1050; dislocation-boundary anisotropy beyond crystallographic texture.

title: Barlat et al 2003. Plane stress yield function for aluminum alloy sheets part 1 theory
historical_review: Publisher abstract/introduction/model and validation snippets read. Yld2000-2d is explicitly plane stress; not directly a full rolling-contact constitutive law.

title: Ghosh Li and Gardiner 2004. A Computational and Experimental Study of Cold Rolling of Aluminum Alloys With Edge Cracking
historical_review: Indexed abstract/references and corroborated DOI only. Aluminium material/friction/damage and 2D/3D comparison; no unverified alloy, fitted parameters or accuracy quoted.

title: Erice Rolfe and Mendiguren 2023. Anisotropic plasticity and fracture modelling of cold rolled AA5754
historical_review: Primary publisher highlights/abstract and repository metadata read; AA5754-H111 temper and non-monotonic rate behaviour verified. Full PDF/methods not read. Test/model lead only, no parameter or validation-split reuse.

title: Papasidero Doquet and Mohr 2015. Ductile fracture of aluminum 2024 T351 under proportional and non proportional multi axial loading Bao Wierzbicki results revisited
historical_review: Full author PDF read at https://old.mohr.ethz.ch/papers/47.pdf. AA2024-T351 tension–torsion, DIC and path effects; constitutive interpretation matters.

title: Bergo Morin and Hopperstad 2021. Numerical implementation of a non local GTN model for explicit FE simulation of ductile damage and fracture
historical_review: Publisher full text read. Current-configuration nonlocal porosity and conditional mesh convergence; numerical methodology, not this mill’s aluminium fracture calibration.

title: Aluminum Extruders Council. Alloys and Tempers
historical_review: Industry authority page read. Alloy-family and treatment orientation in an extrusion context; no rolling material cards or flow curves.

title: Ryen et al 2006. Large strain work hardening of aluminum alloys and the effect of Mg in solid solution
historical_review: Primary publisher abstract read. Compression/cold rolling and stage-IV hardening in a specified Mg range; does not support a universal composition multiplier.

title: Gjønnes and Andersson 1998. Mechanisms of surface deformation during cold rolling of aluminium
historical_review: Primary publisher abstract read. Surface features of initially twin-roll-cast aluminium; distinct from bulk ductile-fracture calibration.

title: Tadić Mišović and Radović 2023. An analysis of longitudinal residual stresses in EN AW 5083 alloy strips as a function of cold rolling process parameters
historical_review: Full open text read. Aluminium laboratory tests and 2D thickness stress model; destructive inversion assumptions. Body/conclusion conflict on friction trend, so no universal sign adopted.

title: Hattori Matsumoto and Utsunomiya 2014. Residual Stress Distribution through Thickness in Cold-Rolled Aluminum Sheet
historical_review: Primary abstract read, not full paper. Stress sign varies with bite geometry/friction; no exact fields or transferable fit used.

title: Tibar and Jiang 2017. Improving Thin Strip Profile Using Work Roll Cross and Work Roll Shifting Methods in Cold Strip Rolling
historical_review: Full article text read. Asymmetric aluminium laboratory mill, unequal diameters/speed ratio. Improved profile with a center buckle in one condition; no symmetric industrial-mill calibration.

title: Mathieu et al 2013. Flatness defects after bridle rolls a numerical analysis of leveling
historical_review: Full author manuscript read at https://hal.univ-lorraine.fr/hal-01501445/document. Aluminium shell/through-thickness model with tension release; mainly numerical, not this stand’s validation.

title: Hacquin Montmitonnet and Guillerault 1998. A three dimensional semi analytical model of rolling stand deformation with finite element validation
historical_review: Publisher abstract and references read. Roll-stack elasticity compared with FE; detailed influence kernels not inspected.

title: Wang Zhang and Ai 2023. Influence of edge thermal spraying on the temperature field and thermal crown of work roll during cold rolling of aluminum alloy strip
historical_review: Primary abstract/references read. Aluminium thermal actuation and industrial application stated; coefficients, response times and detailed measurements unavailable.

title: Shore et al 2018. Multiscale modelling of asymmetric rolling with an anisotropic constitutive law
historical_review: Full primary text read. Aluminium texture-based constitutive study; anisotropy fixed within a pass, not updated over a validated process chain.

title: Kpogan and Potier Ferry 2014. Buckling of long thin plates under residual stresses with application to strip rolling
historical_review: Full author manuscript read at https://hal.univ-lorraine.fr/hal-01503450v1/document. Reduced-width harmonic and weakly nonlinear method, predominantly steel elastic parameters; notation checked dimensionally.

title: Abdelkhalek et al 2009. Coupled and uncoupled approaches for thin cold rolled strip buckling prediction
historical_review: Full text read at https://minesparis-psl.hal.science/hal-00509416/document. Steel example and tensiometer profiles; local relaxation is distinct from nonlinear mode/amplitude prediction.

title: Hosseini and Rodríguez Martínez 2021. A simple and computationally efficient stress integration scheme based on numerical approximation of the yield function gradients: Application to advanced yield criteria
historical_review: Full institutional PDF constitutive/integration/tangent and benchmark sections read. AA2090-T3 examples; solver-specific objective-rate framework, not a rolling-twin runtime or accuracy claim.

title: Liu et al 2020. A 3D phenomenological yield function with both in and out-of-plane mechanical anisotropy using full-field crystal plasticity spectral method for modelling sheet metal forming of strong textured aluminum alloy
historical_review: Full publisher body through appendix read. AA3104-H19 and AA2024-T3 texture/CPFFT-to-continuum, directional/plane-strain/shear and earing evidence; not roll-bite validation.

title: Wen and Mudawar 2005. Emissivity characteristics of polished aluminum alloy surfaces and assessment of multispectral radiation thermometry (MRT) emissivity models
historical_review: Full author PDF experiments/conclusions read at https://engineering.purdue.edu/mudawar/files/articles-all/2005/2005_3.pdf. Polished 1100/2024/7075/7150 at 600–800 K; no cold oily-strip emissivity calibration.

title: Le Sutcliffe Wang and Burstein 2004. Surface oxide fracture in cold aluminium rolling
historical_review: Primary abstract/introduction and methods/conclusion snippets read. Deliberately anodized 1050/1200 strips; mechanism evidence, not a universal native-oxide critical reduction.

title: Sutcliffe 1990. Experimental Measurements of Lubricant Film Thickness in Cold Strip Rolling
historical_review: Primary publisher abstract read. Uneven supply produced film thinner than smooth-surface prediction; full material list not established. Measurement methodology, not an aluminium-specific parameter set.

title: Achenbach OPTIMILL. Aluminium strip rolling mills
historical_review: Official page and actual render inspected. Enclosed stand, supported reel machinery, projecting hoods and service connections; 4-/6-high and bottom-setting-cylinder options documented. Representative arrangement, not dimensions or physics validation.

title: Achenbach. Future Concepts Since 1452
historical_review: Actual PDF pixels inspected on pages 6, 9 and 11 (printed 12, 18 and 22): foil-mill enclosure/access, reel-side machinery and separate media-treatment plant. Visual context only; artwork not reproduced. Corporate image brochure; accessed 30 September 2026. No publication year inferred from URL.

title: Achenbach UniFlat. Flatness measuring rolls
historical_review: Official product description read. Across-width tensile-stress sensing, including closed-surface embodiments. Instrument function and external-design inspiration; no installed calibration assumed.

title: Achenbach UniSpray. Coolant distribution system
historical_review: Official product description read. Individually controlled nozzle valves, rows and local oil application. Inspires separate zone actuators; no universal nozzle pitch or heat-transfer gain.

title: Achenbach UniHeat. Curved hot edge system
historical_review: Official description read. Local work-roll induction heating near strip edges, with exit-side splash-guard mounting described. Not a strip furnace and not proof of hot rolling.

title: Primetals Technologies. Aluminum cold rolling
historical_review: Official portfolio read. Four-/six-high and tandem options; equipment-configuration reference. Stand count, roll-stack height and reversing operation are separate choices.

title: Primetals Technologies. Air Bearing Shapemeter
historical_review: Official installed/component image pixels inspected and product text read. Supported narrow rotor sections and pneumatic load inference; an alternative to solid measuring-roll designs, not an optical scanner.

title: MINO 2021. Mino supplies a new foil finishing mill to Laminazione Sottile
historical_review: OEM-hosted publication: image pixels on PDF pages 2 and 4 inspected; text on page 3 read. No. 2 photograph supports access/enclosure observations; announced No. 3 doubled-foil features are separate. No artwork copied. International Aluminium Journal, November 2021; the later upload date is not the issue date.

title: MINO 2023. New “High-Specification” Six-High Mill Receives Final Acceptance by Customer
historical_review: Official ELVAL case read. Intermediate shifting, thermal treatment and monitoring functions; optional six-high configuration evidence, not a requirement to convert the four-high baseline. The 2023 date comes from the earlier source review, not a fresh date check.

title: MINO Process Control 2025. Bliss cold mill upgrade at ELVAL Greece
historical_review: Official four-high aluminium upgrade case read. AGC/AFC, displacement-transducer and hydraulic integration; public function evidence, not an as-built drawing or control validation for this project.

title: Thermo Scientific. Thermo Scientific RM210AS aluminum x-ray thickness gauge
historical_review: Actual PDF page 2 diagram inspected: separate entry/exit C-frames and opposed measurement heads in a typical aluminium cold/reversing arrangement. Alloy/temperature correction documented; offered capability, not installed accuracy.

title: Achenbach official YouTube. Achenbach Buschhütten Speed
historical_review: Official channel linkage and 5:18 video identity verified. Player remained buffering; no usable machinery frames were viewed. Reference link only, no timestamp-specific design claim or video reproduction.
